title: Didn’t get laundry as clean as I had hoped.
text: Didn’t get laundry as clean as I had hoped.. These are very huge bags that holds a lot but don’t over fill them. Comes with 2 so split up your load. I bought them for the great price in hopes that they would cut down on guinea pig hair and hay in washer. It did keep in the hay on both times I used it. But the guinea pig hair the first time I used these it didn’t trap any. I open up the lid to the washer and found hair was all over the outside of the bags and very little was on the inside. I tried using them again and got better results with the hair getting trapped inside the bags. What I did differently was I used both bags this time. Just separated my guinea pig bedding into each bag. On how clean they got was not great on either time of washing. Debris was still all over the bedding. From hair to fine hay to pee marks and food spots like cherry tomato seeds.  They just still look dirty and I wash my guinea pig bedding on the longest setting. This is my only experience with washing bags maybe this is how they all work.
